title: Recording: All In The Name Of Love, Runaways, Love Is Gonna Get Ya by Ringo Starr | 1991
content:
Capitol Studios, Los Angeles
Producer: Phil Ramone
Engineer: Bill Drescher

Ringo Starr recorded three songs for his tenth solo album, Time Takes Time, on 7 June 1991.

‘All In The Name Of Love’ was written by Jerry Lynn Williams, who also composed songs recorded by Eric Clapton, Robert Plant, BB King, Stevie Ray Vaughan, and Bonnie Raitt.

Along with ‘Runaways’ and the outtake ‘Love Is Gonna Get Ya’, it was produced by Phil Ramone, who also worked with Paul McCartney on Ram, Flowers In The Dirt, Flaming Pie, and the ‘Spies Like Us’ single.

This was also Starr’s first recording with Mark Hudson, who became a key collaborator on Starr’s live and studio albums from 1998 to 2008, co-producing and writing the bulk of the songs.

To this day, Ringo brings up that his voice has never sounded better than with Phil Ramone. He’s the only one who took the care of finding the proper mic, which, I believe, was a [Neumann] U47.
Mark Hudson, 2003
